messages:
Aisha: Quick proposal — shift our weekly triage from Thu to Friday 11:00am PT and shorten to 20m. Fewer context switches before EOW and gives product time to drop last-minute bugs. If youre +1 react :thumbsup:, -1 react :thumbsdown:. Proposed compact agenda below + rotation for facilitators.

Aisha: ```Agenda (20m)
1) Quick backlog snapshot (3-5m) — owners callouts
2) Top 5 bugs (10m) — owners assigned, quick decisions
3) Blockers & rollouts (3m)
4) Follow-ups & action items (2m)
```

Miguel: +1 from me. Friday avoids a lot of mid-week churn. Can we keep a short "canary" bug lane review (1-2 bugs max)?

Priya: Id prefer Thu usually but fine to try. Would like an async pre-read for owners (status bullets) — can we use a single doc? https://docs.internal/triage/weekly-prep

Ethan: +1. SRE should be on rotation every other week for infra signals. Also suggest we include CI flakiness quick-check.

Teresa: happy to run the first Friday. Will create the calendar invite and add the pre-read link.

deploy-bot: Calendar invite created: Weekly Triage (Fri 11:00am PT) — created by Teresa. Recurrence: weekly.

Aisha: Thanks — proposed facilitator rotation: Teresa -> Miguel -> Priya -> Ethan (then repeat). I'll add that to the invite. Current bug queue: 42 open (P1=2, P2=9, P3=31).

Miguel: can we add a one-line "regressions / CI" label check to top of agenda? saves time.

Priya: ack. Also: can we keep the meeting to 20m hard cap? If items need longer, spin out a follow-up deep-dive.

Aisha: agreed — 20m hard cap. I'll update invite + add agenda template and owner pre-read checklist. If anyone strongly objects to Fri 11:00 ping me before EOD.

Ethan: noted. I'll be on for the first two Fridays.

Teresa: invite updated with agenda + pre-read doc. See you Friday :rocket:
